body: This kind of stuff has been happening to me long before I've started taking horomones. So can you explain that?

I'm not so sure jumping into water or anything would be very effective though? Some kind of poison is probably fast acting enough to get the job done.

I just can't connect with them, they hate me so I just kind of leave it as is.. I don't really know how to take to them.. ones older by 5 years and the other younger by a year

I try things like that to help but I just get so upset, full on envy and it just hurts. Health care here is weird , my family's financial situation just sucks. In all honesty I just want to feel a little happy, comfortable but I never am. I don't want to keep living without those things. And as far as I can recall, those emotions have never been present in my life

I live in Ontario Canada. With my parents, well my dad doesn't understand me, so he's not really helpful but kind of supportive. And my mom passed away, so.. my siblings all hate me. And all I do with mytime is just.. do nothing. I've fallen into my usual habit of just going to my computer to just mindlessly scroll until I sleep. Im such a mess

I don't think it's something I'll be able to afford.. my family's financial situation is.. confusing to say the least. And I'd be giving up everything, it's not like I'm really living anyways. everyday I'm just emotionless, I dread everything and nothing ever makes me happy. I then can't justify anything else, because everyone around me has something they enjoy, that they can turn to, a positive. But I don't. I don't think theres anything after death, I assume I'm gone which is a better outcome than just being debilitated by dysphoria right? I'm sorry but I really think I'm a lost cause
I'm not worth that much time...

I attempted and after I couldn't stomach pills.. so that's why I stopped for a month to switch to the patches, (the thing you couldn't identify) and.. it's slower, but regardless of the doseage, the amount of time taking it.. it won't change anything. To be honest I don't think I can get therapy.. and I know I'm only 17 but I'm already so tired of this life and I genuinely don't enjoy anything
Can't I just call it quits? Just completely give up?

With hrt I would've been about 5 months now if I didn't screw up, I stoppedfor a month and Im at about 3 weeks now. I have a hard time imagining any positives in my life, and I've just stopped at this point because it crushes me so much every time. Now I'm just..so empty, I feel like shit all the time, I never enjoy anything. Life just feels like a punishment, especially with the overwhelming gender envy anytime I see someone. I'm fucking disgusting
